cmd:
cd /root/unitex-finrep/computed; for i in $(seq 1 20); do [ $(( $(date +%s) - $(stat -c %Y ap_register.csv) )) -lt 600 ] && break; sleep 5; done; date '+зараз %H:%M'; stat -c '%y %n' ap_register.csv dashboard_data.json | cut -c1-16,30-; python3 -c "
import csv,json
rows=[r for r in csv.DictReader(open('ap_register.csv',encoding='utf-8')) if r.get('deal_number')=='251']
print('кредиторка по угоді 251:')
for r in rows: print('   рах.%-6s сума %-9s борг %-8s %s' % (r['number'],r['amount_uo'],r['debt_uo'],r['invoice_status']))
d=json.load(open('dashboard_data.json'))
ap=d.get('apDetail') or []
print('кредиторка разом: груп %d, рядків %d, сума %.2f' % (len(ap), sum(len(g['rows']) for g in ap), sum(g['total'] for g in ap)))
print('Украмарин у кредиторці:', [ (g['name'],g['total']) for g in ap if 'крамарин' in g['name']])
"
